summary: Phase 4: Observation Flow UI Updates - Backend APIs verified working, frontend code review completed. All 28 backend tests pass (14 Phase 4 + 14 Phase 3). Preview URL was unavailable (agent sleeping) so frontend UI testing could not be performed via browser automation.

backend_limits_summary_api.details: GET /api/subscriptions/limits-summary returns tier_key, tier_name, coaches, observations_per_coach info correctly

backend_batch_observation_api.details: POST /api/subscriptions/observation-limit/batch returns status for multiple coaches with current_count, limit, is_unlimited, can_observe fields

backend_single_coach_observation_api.details: GET /api/subscriptions/observation-limit/{coach_id} returns can_observe, current_count, limit, is_unlimited, message, tier_key

api_authentication.details: All subscription APIs correctly require authentication (401 without token)

coach_developer_tier_10_limit.details: coach_developer tier correctly shows 10 observations per coach limit

frontend_code_implementation.details: SessionSetup.jsx correctly imports and uses fetchBulkCoachObservationStatus, formatObservationLimit, getObservationLimitClass, canObserveCoach. Coach dropdown shows observation counts (X/10 format). Warning/error alerts implemented for approaching/reached limits. Start Observation button blocked when limit reached.

frontend_ui_testing.details: Preview URL unavailable (agent sleeping) - browser automation could not access the page

action_items: Manual verification recommended: Access SessionSetup page at /session/new and verify coach dropdown shows observation counts (0/10 format)
Manual verification recommended: Select a coach and confirm limit status message appears below dropdown
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend implementation looks complete: SessionSetup.jsx correctly integrates observation limits from subscriptionApi.js
Helper functions (formatObservationLimit, canObserveCoach, getObservationLimitClass) are well-structured with proper null checks
UI displays appropriate messaging: normal status, warning (approaching limit), and error (limit reached)
Start Observation button correctly blocked when coach is at limit with toast error
